steps.title: Prepare frozen fecal sample
steps.instruction: Weigh ~15 mg of flash‑frozen feces into a 2 mL container, add 250 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ Lysis Solution and homogenize with a pestle while submerged in liquid nitrogen or on dry ice; add a further 500 µL Lysis Solution (final volume 750 µL), vortex, spin the container 10 s in a minicentrifuge, then transfer the entire 750 µL to a ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tube (0.1 & 0.5 mm).

steps.title: Prepare shielded fecal sample
steps.instruction: Mix the Zymo DNA/RNA Shield™ fecal solution by vortexing, add up to 250 µL to a ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tube (0.1 & 0.5 mm), bring the volume to 1 mL with ZymoBIOMICS™ Lysis Solution, cap tightly.

steps.title: Prepare other stabilized sample
steps.instruction: Mix the fecal solution from other stabilization kits, add 250 µL to a ZR BashingBead™ Lysis Tube (0.1 & 0.5 mm), add 750 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ Lysis Solution, cap tightly.

steps.title: Bead‑beat lysate
steps.instruction: Secure the tube in an Omni Bead Ruptor Elite with a 2 mL tube holder, run at max speed (30 m/s) for 5 min, then rest the tube for 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the ZR BashingBead™ tubes at ≥10 000 × g, °C, for 1 min in a microcentrifuge.

steps.title: Collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 600 µL supernatant to a Zymo‑Spin™ III‑F Filter placed in a labelled collection tube, centrifuge at 8 000 × g for 1 min, then discard the filter.

steps.title: Add DNA binding buffer (first portion)
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Binding Buffer to the filtrate in the collection tube and mix well.

steps.title: Add DNA binding buffer (second portion)
steps.instruction: Add additional DNA Binding Buffer so that the total volume of buffer added reaches 1 200 µL.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column (first load)
steps.instruction: Transfer 800 µL of the mixture to a Zymo‑Spin™ IICR Column in a collection tube, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column (second load)
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through, then repeat the previous loading step with the remaining mixture and centrifuge again at 10 000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer 1
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 1 to the IICR Column in a new collection tube, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min, discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer 2 (first)
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 2 to the column, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min, discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer 2 (final)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ DNA Wash Buffer 2, centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min, discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the IICR Column to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, add 100 µL (minimum 50 µL) ZymoBIOMICS™ DNase/RNase‑Free Water directly onto the matrix, incubate 5 min, then centrifuge at 10 000 × g for 1 min to collect the eluate.

steps.title: Store eluted DNA
steps.instruction: Freeze the eluted DNA at –30 °C to –15 °C or at –90 °C to –65 °C for downstream applications.

steps.title: HRC purification – add prep solution
steps.instruction: Place a Zymo‑Spin™ III‑HRC Filter in a new collection tube, add 600 µL ZymoBIOMICS™ HRC Prep Solution, centrifuge at 8 000 × g for 3 min.

steps.title: HRC purification – bind DNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the eluate from step 14 to the prepared III‑HRC Filter in a clean 1.5 mL tube, centrifuge at exactly 16 000 × g for 3 min.
